value.name: Rosa cries silently
value.description: Rosa begins crying without making a sound, letting long-held tears run down her face.
evidence: The tears were running down her face in the orderly way of tears that have been held for a long time and are now being permitted, finally, to do what tears do.

value.name: Rosa remains still at the table
value.description: Rosa does not wipe her tears and keeps her hands folded in the same posture as before, showing resignation and grief.
evidence: She sat with her hands folded on the table in front of her in the same posture she had held them in on the kitchen chair the night before, and she let her face be wet.

value.name: Lucia looks down at the table
value.description: Lucia avoids eye contact and stares at the table in silence.
evidence: Lucia was looking at the table.

value.name: Daniel studies the letter
value.description: Daniel focuses on the letter with the hope that it might be something other than what it appears to be.
evidence: Daniel was looking at the letter.
He was looking at it the way a man looks at a thing he has hoped, until this moment, was something else.

value.name: Daniel rejects the handwriting as fake
value.description: Daniel says the handwriting is not his mother's and realizes someone has tried to imitate it.
evidence: "That isn't her handwriting," he said again. "That's — that's someone trying to do her handwriting.

value.name: Daniel points out forged letter details
value.description: Daniel argues from the shape of the letter's D that the note was forged and not written by his mother.
evidence: "Look at the — look at how she's done the *D* in *Daniel.* My mother didn't make a *D* like that. My mother made a *D* with a loop. That *D* doesn't have a loop."

value.name: Daniel doubles down on accusation
value.description: After realizing his first remark was wrong, Daniel chooses to repeat and elaborate on his claim instead of retracting it.
evidence: It was the wrong thing to say. He knew it was the wrong thing to say.
She watched his face register the wrongness even as the words were still in the air between them, and she watched him decide, in the half-second after, whether to walk it back or to commit to it.

value.name: Lucia reacts and stands up
value.description: Lucia lifts her head, looks at Daniel in silence, and then rises from the table to move toward the sideboard.
evidence: She looked at her brother for a long quiet moment, and then she got up from the table and went to the sideboard
